import copy
import unittest

from solution import pivot_rows


class PivotRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_transpose(self):
        rows = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]
        original = copy.deepcopy(rows)
        result = pivot_rows(rows)
        self.assertEqual(result, [[1, 4], [2, 5], [3, 6]])
        self.assertEqual(rows, original)
        self.assertIsNot(result, rows)

    def test_empty_outer_and_empty_rectangular_rows(self):
        self.assertEqual(pivot_rows([]), [])
        rows = [[], [], []]
        result = pivot_rows(rows)
        self.assertEqual(result, [])
        self.assertIsNot(result, rows)

    def test_nested_cells_are_deep_copied(self):
        shared = {"values": [1]}
        rows = [[shared, shared], [{"values": [2]}, [3, {"x": 4}]]]
        original = copy.deepcopy(rows)
        result = pivot_rows(rows)
        self.assertEqual(result, [[{"values": [1]}, {"values": [2]}], [{"values": [1]}, [3, {"x": 4}]]])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0][0], shared)
        self.assertIsNot(result[1][0], shared)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0][0], result[1][0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0][0]["values"], shared["values"])
        result[0][0]["values"].append(9)
        self.assertEqual(result[1][0], {"values": [1]})
        self.assertEqual(rows, original)

    def test_single_row_and_single_column(self):
        self.assertEqual(pivot_rows([[1, 2]]), [[1], [2]])
        self.assertEqual(pivot_rows([[1], [2], [3]]), [[1, 2, 3]])

    def test_rejects_non_list_outer_value(self):
        for bad in (None, (), "rows", {}):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    pivot_rows(bad)

    def test_rejects_non_list_rows(self):
        for rows in (([1], (2,)), [[1], "x"], [None]):
            with self.subTest(rows=rows):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    pivot_rows(rows)

    def test_rejects_ragged_rows(self):
        for rows in ([[1], []], [[], [1]], [[1, 2], [3]]):
            with self.subTest(rows=rows):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    pivot_rows(rows)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
